title: SRE weekly update 2026-04-11
content:
Summary:
- Busy week for oncall: two Sev2 incidents, one Sev3 degradation. No data loss.
- Focus: stabilize autoscaler behaviour during bursty traffic, improve 99th pct latency for hosted-api.
- Postmortem in progress for Incident SRE-357 (autoscaler thrash) — initial RCA points to race in scale-down path and a noisy healthcheck pattern from a customer test harness.

Incidents:
1) 2026-04-08 01:15 UTC — Sev2: hosted-api high tail latency (SRE-357)
   - Symptom: 99p token latency spiked from ~270ms to ~720ms for ~45m window. Errors were elevated (5xx from idle-eviction).
   - Impact: degraded customer latency, transient 5xx for some requests. No customer data exposure.
   - Triage: oncall paged infra, throttled bursty client via temporary QoS rule, scaled up dedicated pool fallback for affected orgs.
   - Mitigation: rolled back autoscaler config under suspicion, applied patch to healthcheck smoothing.
   - Next: full postmortem draft (linked_artifacts above), add healthcheck smoothing to default autoscaler profile. Owner: Marcus Li.

2) 2026-04-09 18:40 UTC — Sev3: metrics ingestion lag (internal)
   - Symptom: internal metrics pipeline lagged ~12m due to a worker GC storm after a recent patch.
   - Impact: delayed alerts and dashboard staleness, no customer impact.
   - Action: reverted the memory tuning change, increased headroom for metrics workers.
   - Next: add guardrail to alert if metrics ingestion lag >5m. Owner: Lena Rodriguez.

SLOs and Reliability Metrics:
- Hosted text-generation 99p token latency SLO: target 300ms. Current week: 99p = 410ms (breach).
  - Contributing factors: autoscaler thrash + increased prefix cache miss rate after model rollout.
  - Short-term: apply autoscaler smoothing and increase small-pool warm capacity during business hours.
  - Long-term: implement adaptive pre-warming in routing layer (spike-detection + warm-up policy).
- Error rate SLO: target <0.5% 5xx. This week: 0.8% during incidents, overall 0.18%.
- Availability: 99.95% for Dedicated pools — met.

On-call Handoffs / Schedule:
- This week rota: Priya (primary), Ethan (secondary), Marcus (weekend).
- Handoff notes for 2026-04-11:
  - Open items: SRE-357 postmortem draft (Marcus), autoscaler config test harness (Ethan), metrics lag guardrail (Lena).
  - Known issues to watch: noisy healthchecks from loadtest clients, increased cache miss for model-v2 rollout.
  - Runbooks: autoscaling-runbook, model-rollout-fallback — ensure you have the latest runbooks from Confluence.

Operational Work / Projects:
- Autoscaler hardening (WIP): PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/842; testing in staging. Expect gradual rollout next week. Owner: Marcus.
- Model rollout stability: investigating prefix cache regressions after model-v2 deploys. Temporary mitigation: route high-QPS customers to model-v1 for 24h. Owner: Priya.
- Chaos experiments: postponed until autoscaler fix lands.

Meeting notes / Standups (high level):
- Mon standup: synced on SRE-357, triage plan.
- Wed deep-dive: autoscaler internals — identified race on scale-down. Action: add single-writer lock to scale decision path.
- Fri review: validated staging patch reduced thrash in 2h soak test.

Action items (short list):
- Marcus: finish postmortem draft and proposed config changes (due 2026-04-14).
- Ethan: add synthetic healthcheck smoothing tests to CI (due 2026-04-16).
- Lena: implement metrics-ingestion guardrail alert (JIRA SRE-360) (due 2026-04-18).
- Priya: coordinate model-v2 rollback plan for affected customers and communicate with CS.

Risks / Notes:
- Model rollout cadence is outpacing our prewarm capacity; risk of repeat tail-latency events if rollout continues without adaptive prewarm.
- Upcoming holiday (US) next week may reduce oncall coverage; consider adjust schedule for critical windows.

Appendix / Links:
- Postmortem draft: JIRA-SRE-357
- Autoscaler runbook: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/SRE/Autoscaler+Runbook
- Infra PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/842
- Metrics alert: JIRA-SRE-360

Notes to self (rough):
- keep follow-ups short in next handoff.
- remind product about rollout blast radius controls (canary %s, warm pool reservations).
